## Change

Describe the problem and resulting player behavior. Include before/after screenshots for visible changes.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results, and any limitations. For networking/rules, cover both solo and a two-client room. For controls/camera, cover desktop and landscape phone layouts.

## Assets and compatibility

If models/dependencies/rules changed, note source revisions and licenses, migration/protocol effects, and updated contributor documentation. Do not attach credentials or private CAD files.
